Landscape Capital Management Lifted Its Bed Bath & Beyond (BBBY) Holding; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Rockland Trust Co Has Cut Its Stake
June 19, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Rockland Trust Co decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rockland Trust Co sold 2,124 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 18,808 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.16 million, down from 20,932 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rockland Trust Co who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $927.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.05% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $188.74. About 14.84M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. The hedge fund held 158,917 shares of the home furnishings company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.34M, up from 49,327 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Landscape Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Bed Bath & Beyond Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.83 billion market cap company.
